title: Microsoft and Japan dismantle global scam messaging network
excerpt: A joint investigation between Microsoft and Japan's National Police Agency has taken down a cybercrime marketplace responsible for over a billion scam messages.
body_html:
Microsoft has announced its collaboration with Japan's National Police Agency to successfully dismantle a major cybercrime marketplace. The targeted network was responsible for distributing more than a billion phishing and scam messages worldwide.

Many people frequently receive deceptive text messages concerning fake package deliveries or nonexistent parking tickets. The recent joint investigation tracked the origins of this widespread scam activity directly to the dismantled marketplace, helping to disrupt the infrastructure utilized by fraudsters globally.
